records.decision: Hold / exclude from this handheld port batch
records.reason: Maintainer describes OpenStrike as a CS-like standalone FPS using maps from a user-owned Counter-Strike copy and native PSP/Vita/3DS/desktop builds. Current evidence does not establish it as a port, decompilation, recompilation, or faithful reimplementation of Counter-Strike; classifying the project as a Counter-Strike target would overstate the relationship. A separate game-key/Wikipedia exact-title fallback for OpenStrike would also need identification review.
Source snapshot contains only a minimal README, no meaningful source-language evidence or license statement, and does not adequately substantiate the implementation/status.
README evidence is stale/thin and the repository does not declare a license; no sufficiently source-backed current status for this pass.

Small Vita game port is a possible future entry, but game identity/canonical source facts and asset/code licensing are mixed and would need fuller fact and license review; this pass prioritized clearer evidence.
Not selected after review; target/app and source-to-target evidence did not add a clearer distinct handheld preservation record than accepted candidates.
Not selected; standalone homebrew port/release lead was not sufficiently documented for this batch as a port of an original game target.
